title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
summary: Characters stay in a T-pose and the symbiote breaks on M1-M4 Macs: D3DMetal reads and writes typed buffers only to element 2^28.

credits.name: macprotips
credits.note: The diagnosis, the raw views and the four rewritten shaders (public domain). MacGameFix adds a carrier that needs no DLL override and a barrier after the volumetric fog copy.

excerpts.note: macprotips': the wide R32 views past element 2^28 are created raw, which D3DMetal reads in full.
Ours: a UAV barrier after the volumetric fog copy, which removed the black blocks in the sandstorm stage.
